extraction.Name: Elias Swallow
extraction.Recorded patent: The patent was recorded May 3, 1921 by the Todd County State Bank
extraction.Buyer: Elias and Lizzie Swallow conveyed lots 3, 4, and 5 and the southeast quarter of the northwest quarter of section 6 to Sol Ritts for $3500.00; on June 24, 1926 the remainder was conveyed by Elias Swallow and Mrs. Nellie Swallow to Amelia Night Pipe for $1.00 and other valuable consideration
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 612437 issued; land described as south half of the northeast quarter and southeast quarter of northwest quarter and lots 1, 2, 3, 4, and 5 of section 6, township 39, range 27; receipt for patent signed by allottee on February 28, 1919; conveyance to Sol Ritts on November 20, 1923; Mrs. Nellie Swallow also joined in the conveyance of the remainder to Amelia Night Pipe
